description: Know-your-agent check before you pay or hire an agent: reads the ERC-8004 Identity Registry (0x8004A169…a432) at a pinned block on base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, gnosis or celo and returns ownerOf, getAgentWallet and tokenURI, fetches the registration file (https/ipfs/data) with its sha256, and checks that the file's agentWallet and registrations[] match the chain. Includes the exact eth_call data so anyone can re-check. Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid with x402 (MCP transport: an unpaid call returns the x402 PaymentRequired object; retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over HTTP: GET /api/erc8004-agent.

block.description: optional block number to pin (default latest)

name: erc8004_agent
title: ERC-8004 agent identity lookup (8 chains)
